llm.summary: This is a documentation-only APIDot Kling 2.6 helper with no executable code, automation, or hidden credential handling.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to route users to APIDot Kling 2.6 API docs and provide async workflow guidance; the artifact content matches that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are scoped to documentation lookup, safe API key handling, polling, webhooks, and integration planning; no prompt-injection, role-change, or hidden-control instructions were found.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains only SKILL.md and references/api.md markdown files, with no install scripts, executable helpers, bundled clients, or automation.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: It declares an optional APIDOT_API_KEY for real API use and repeatedly instructs agents to keep it server-side and avoid live calls unless explicitly requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill itself does not persist data or request privileges; persistence guidance is limited to application-level task IDs, statuses, media references, and final URLs for normal async video workflows.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you want APIDot Kling 2.6 API documentation guidance. Keep any APIDOT_API_KEY in a server-side secret store, and review live APIDot docs before making real API calls because the skill intentionally avoids embedding current request payloads or pricing details.
